name: jev-ios-bridge
description: Check iOS and Android apps (SwiftUI, UIKit, Jetpack Compose, Compose Multiplatform, Android Views) on a simulator, or an emulator or phone (phones untested), with scripted steps and Jev-judged screen claims

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Your key for Jev, from TypeSafe. Kept in your system's secure storage, never in a project file.

simulator_udid.title: Simulator UDID
simulator_udid.description: For iOS: UUID of a simulator that only these checks drive (xcrun simctl list devices). Aliases such as booted are refused. Leave empty if you only check Android apps.

android_device.title: Android device
android_device.description: For Android: the adb serial of a device, or the AVD name of an emulator, that only these checks drive. A script's device.serial or device.avd overrides it. Leave empty if you only check iOS apps.
